limitations: Synthetic host inputs only; no physical sensor or RP2350 performance claims.
Seed coverage is specific to each listed factor group; this report does not establish coverage for factors absent from its input CSV.
Mahony and gyro-only are attitude-only reference estimators; navigation states, covariance, and NEES/NIS are not applicable and are explicitly marked.
The reference Mahony uses fixed proportional and integral gains of 1.0 and 0.05; its heading correction gain is fixed at 0.25. These comparison baselines are not tuned products.
Tilt NEES and gravity NIS are consistency diagnostics because simulator truth, propagated IMU and gravity pseudo-measurements are not fully independent.
